ok.meaning: Whether the restore stop succeeded in its current phase. It restores Forgejo from the fixed /mnt/nas/backups/forgejo/nas/export/ tree only when complete is present.

status.meaning: The transient worker was accepted; this does not assert a finished restore.

unit.meaning: Name of the accepted transient worker unit.

step.meaning: Phase that refused or failed, when named.

reason.meaning: Unprefixed refusal or failure reason, when named.

firstMissingSignal.meaning: Outcome signal emitted by the stop; none denotes no missing signal.
